description:
Mod manager for universal game mods


- Add support for game-specific installable mods (HeavenVR for Neon White, Two Forks VR for Firewatch, others soon).
- Add support for link-only mods (mods that are just a link to some website telling you how to install that mod).
- Improve creation of app shortcut on Linux.
- Show prompt on first time startup for Steam Deck users, suggesting that you add Rai Pal to Steam to make it easier to start.
- Custom mod configs are now installed as "mods" too. Supports auto-installing recommended configs for any mod like UEVR, UUVR, etc (ask Rai if you wanna submit your config).
- Add mod searching and filtering to the mods tab, since we now have hundreds of "mods", including external links, game-specific mods, and configs.
- Add "Update all" button for mods in game page.
- Detect broken mod files and show "Reinstall all" button that clears the junk and keeps only working mods.
- Remember the last selected game when opening Rai Pal.
- Auomatically select game after adding it manually (like by dragging the exe).
- Faster app startup and refresh.
- Further reduced memory usage.
- Faster mod actions for Windows games that run via Proton/Wine on Linux.
- Fix some cases where the "single instance" enforcement would cause the app not to start at all.
- Fix installed mods no longer showing as installed after a Rai Pal update in some cases.
- Fix manually added games not disappearing after being deleted.
- Fix stale information in game rows after installing or uninstalling games.
